claims: As of March 20, 2026, Sanae Takaichi is the Prime Minister of Japan.
Sanae Takaichi took office on October 21, 2025.
Sanae Takaichi is the leader of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP).
Sanae Takaichi met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House to discuss bilateral security and cooperation.
Sanae Takaichi succeeded former Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba.
Sanae Takaichi held a bilateral meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington, D.C., on March 19, 2026.
The discussions between Sanae Takaichi and U.S. President Donald Trump focused on security.
The discussions between Sanae Takaichi and U.S. President Donald Trump focused on bilateral cooperation.
The discussions between Sanae Takaichi and U.S. President Donald Trump focused on strengthening the U.S.-Japan alliance.
Shigeru Ishiba was Prime Minister of Japan from Oct 2024 to Oct 2025.
Fumio Kishida was Prime Minister of Japan from Nov 2021 to Oct 2024.
